section.title: Restarting the engine from Idle STOP mode

li.p: Press the clutch pedal when the vehicle is in N (Neutral).
The Late Restart function operates only when the vehicle is on level ground and stable.
To start the engine when the brake is not pressed or a gear is already engaged, press the brake pedal first, and then press the clutch pedal for safety.
To start the engine without vehicle movement while the brake pedal is pressed (if equipped with Late Restart):
Press and release the clutch pedal.
Immediately press the clutch pedal again.
After the vehicle has stalled, the engine will restart if you follow these steps:
Release the clutch pedal after the engine has completely stopped.
